why: Manin's conjecture is proved case-by-case for classes of Fano varieties; post-snapshot papers claim it for quintic del Pezzo surfaces with a conic bundle structure (2025), quartic del Pezzo fibrations, and the chordal cubic fourfold, each settling a case of the stated conjecture.
queries: Manin conjecture Fano varieties rational points proof 2025
Manin conjecture wikipedia rational points bounded height Fano

found.title: Manin's conjecture for quintic del Pezzo surfaces with a conic bundle structure
found.note: Claims proof of Manin's conjecture (matching upper/lower bounds, full conjecture in Galois general case) for infinitely many quintic del Pezzo surfaces with conic bundle structure; not read.

found.title: On Manin's conjecture for quartic del Pezzo fibrations
found.note: Claims a version of Manin's conjecture, including Peyre's leading constant, for nontrivial quartic del Pezzo fibrations; not read.

found.title: Manin's conjecture for the chordal cubic fourfold
found.note: Claims the thin-set version of the rational-point-count conjecture with explicit leading constant for the chordal cubic fourfold; not read.

found.title: Homological stability and Manin's conjecture for rational curves on quartic del Pezzo surfaces
found.note: Claims a version of Manin's conjecture over F_q (q large) for maps from rational curves to split quartic del Pezzo surfaces; not read.
